title: Enterprise Connectivity: remaining remittance funds
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this remaining remittance funds rule to assisted overpayment payout.

## Basis: remitted funds
For assisted overpayment payout, read the amount only from the exact selected remittance recorded as a posted ACH payment; its posted bank-confirmed negative amount supplies the positive remitted funds magnitude after negation.

## Basis: already returned funds
For assisted overpayment payout, sum posted payment-return and refund amount values linked to the exact selected remittance; those events restoring the payment funds are positive, and other payments are excluded.

## Basis Q&A
